title: Invoice Line Auditor
description: Recalculates invoice subtotal, tax, and total from structured line items and compares the result with a stated total. It exposes line-level arithmetic for review.
decision: The result is match when the absolute difference between the stated and calculated totals is within the explicit tolerance. Otherwise it reports mismatch and the signed difference without approving or paying the invoice.
inputs: The caller supplies one or more uniquely identified lines with nonnegative quantity and unit price and a tax rate from zero through one. A nonnegative stated total is required, and an optional bounded tolerance defaults to one cent.
limitations: The core checks arithmetic only and cannot validate delivery, tax jurisdiction, contract terms, discounts, currency, authenticity, or duplicate invoices across systems. It does not approve, reject, book, or pay an invoice.
